exact_statement: Fix C>=0 and a nonconstant finite uniform Boolean seed f with H(f)-CI(f)>0. Pad with r dummy coordinates and flip physical vertex zero to get F_N, N=n+r. For every dummy j, average child slack sigma_j(F_N)=-(delta(f)+delta(F_(N-1)))/2 tends to -delta(f)<0. Every original coordinate slack converges to its seed slack. If all original average child slacks are strictly positive, then eventually the average-child-eligible coordinates are exactly the original coordinates and their minimum B_i/Inf_i tends to E(f), although the unrestricted minimum tends to min(E(f),2). For the three-bit point defect, N=12,C=8/3, F_N has full Fourier support, max influence<1/4 and positive delta; all original coordinates have nonnegative individual child slacks and B_i/Inf_i>5/2, while all nine dummy coordinates have both individual child slacks negative and B_j/Inf_j<5/2. Thus root selection B_i<=5Inf_i/2 does not imply selection with certified average children at C=8/3 on this class. Moreover, with Q_C(f)=min_i [B_i(f)+max(-sigma_i(f),0)]/Inf_i(f), Q_C(F_N) tends to Q_C(f) for every fixed violating seed, with no seed-child positivity assumption; every dummy corrected price is asymptotic to delta(f)*2^(N-1) and diverges.

exact_statement: Fix C>=0 and define sigma_i(f)=average_b[CI(f_i,b)-H(f_i,b)], q_C,i=(B_i+max(-sigma_i,0))/Inf_i and Q_C=min over relevant i, with constants assigned0. For any nonconstant Boolean seed f, delta=H(f)-CI(f), its t-fold disjoint tensor satisfies Q_C(f^tensor t)=min_i max(B_i/Inf_i,C+(t delta-JS_i)/Inf_i). If delta>0 then Q_C(f^tensor t)/t tends to delta/max_i Inf_i>0. Thus, for M_C(N)=sup Q_C over signs with at most N relevant inputs, universal FEI(C), finite sup_f Q_C, and M_C(N)=o(N) are equivalent at the exact same C; under FEI(C), Q_C<=C, while any violating seed on n relevant inputs gives liminf M_C(N)/N>=delta/(n max_i Inf_i). For every fixed tau,eta in(0,1), the same equivalence holds if a bounded or o(N) corrected-price envelope is required only on full-Fourier-support signs with I<=tau, max_i Inf_i<=tau and mean>=1-eta. Indeed balanced tensor point activation with k=ceil(sqrt(t)), followed by two dummies and one physical point flip, gives actual full-support E_t with N_t=tn+k+3, I->0, mean->1, H/I->seed H/I and liminf Q_C(E_t)/N_t>=delta/n. This is a same-C completeness/obstruction theorem, not a finite universal payment.

exact_statement: For every fixed nonconstant uniform Boolean seed h on n relevant bits, take t tensor copies on D=tn bits, append r=min{s:2^s-s-1>=D} physical parity tags with distinct weight-at-least-two labels, then flip physical zero. The actual resulting G_t on N=D+r bits is prime across every nontrivial coordinate partition, has every Fourier coefficient nonzero and every input relevant, and H(G_t)/I(G_t) tends to H(h)/I(h). Every singleton collision is <=8*2^-N; every pair collision and total of its two merging refunds is <=16*2^-N. Hence the sums over all pairs are each <=16*binom(N,2)*2^-N and tend to zero. For every fixed epsilon>0, the class of prime full-Fourier-support signs with both total pair quantities <=epsilon has exactly the universal extended-real optimal FEI constant, with no factor-three loss. If H(h)-K I(h)>0 at fixed K>=0, every actual singleton and pair child of G_t violates FEI(K) for sufficiently large t. Thus no such admitted root is a minimal K-violator. A compressed actual N=200 certificate from the three-bit point defect at t64,K8/3 verifies a positive root gap and uniformly positive deficits of all individual singleton/pair children, without enumerating its truth table.
